title: Additional Subsidies or Financial Support for Senior Households Living in HDB Flats on Fixed or No Incomes
what_it_is: Additional Subsidies or Financial Support for Senior Households Living in HDB Flats on Fixed or No Incomes

sections.label: Support schemes for seniors
sections.summary: The passage describes the Lease Buyback Scheme, Enhancement for Active Seniors, GST Voucher scheme and Silver Support payments for seniors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Jeffrey Siow) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Seniors can unlock the value of their flat and receive a regular stream of income through the Lease Buyback Scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Jeffrey Siow) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Government provides a cash bonus of up to $30,000 for eligible Lease Buyback Scheme participants, on top of the proceeds from selling a portion of their flat's remaining lease.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Jeffrey Siow) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: To improve seniors' mobility and safety within their flat, in-home senior-friendly fittings and accessibility solutions, such as grab bars and ramps, are also subsidised via the Enhancement for Active Seniors programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Jeffrey Siow) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Government also provides direct support for living costs through the permanent Goods and Services Tax Voucher scheme, which comprising cash, MediSave, U-Save rebates and rebates for Service and Conservancy Charges.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Jeffrey Siow) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Seniors who earned low income during their working years and thus have low retirement savings may also receive quarterly Silver Support payments in cash.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Jeffrey Siow) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: This was recently enhanced in 2025, with eligible seniors receiving up to $1,080 each quarter, up from $900 previously.

sections.label: Lease Buyback Scheme subscription rate
sections.summary: The passage states the Lease Buyback Scheme subscription rate has been going up and that more will be done to encourage seniors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: We will be looking very closely at the this group and seeing how much more we can support them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: But specific to the Lease Buyback Scheme, the subscription rate has, in fact, been going up.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: We will continue to do more to encourage seniors, who wish to take this opportunity to monetise their housing asset, to be able to do that, and to age in place at the same time.
